revision_history.change: Refresh from the public source with a sealed manifest, input QA and downloadable chart values.
Restore classifier confidence buckets, include zero-count years and qualify source retention and analyst-defined rules.

methodology: Canonical IncidentClassifier(source='bsee'), activity == DRILL; severity is an accident-type proxy, not injury or fatality counts.

classification_basis.regulatory_scope: 30 CFR 250.188 (2025), reporting categories only; not a historical coding dictionary or a severity scale.
classification_basis.severity_method: First matching term group in _severity; accident-type vocabulary comes from the source member. Labels do not establish consequence magnitude or individual injury counts.
classification_basis.keyword_method: KEYWORDS is a screening vocabulary, not an official service taxonomy; literal case-insensitive matches may overlap.
classification_basis.confidence_basis: Historical reporting thresholds applied to canonical IncidentClassifier confidence; scores are not calibrated probabilities.

reporting_changes: Percentages are rounded to one decimal place.
drill_top_areas and the area CSV include all observed DRILL area codes.
Confidence buckets retain the historical reporting thresholds.
Year values cover every calendar year in the screened date range, including zero DRILL counts; zero does not establish zero incidents.
limitations: Investigation records are not a complete incident census or a risk rate.
Operational phases are derived from accident-type text, not reported service types.
Composite keys detect exact event signatures; no public unique incident ID is supplied.
Lease is optional; no operator identity, narrative or asset name is exported.
No durable source archive is supplied with this report. Exact replay requires retained bytes matching both manifest digests; a later public download may differ.
